articles.title: Bats May Have First Evolved in Europe 65 Million Years Ago
articles.summary: A study in Nature combined 103 bat genomes with 44 fossils. It suggests bats originated in Europe in the late Paleocene, and that flight and echolocation appeared early.

articles.title: "Plant Armor" Textile More Than Triples Strawberry Yields in Field Trials
articles.summary: North Carolina State University researchers say a breathable fabric cover raised strawberry yields by as much as 3.56 times in tunnel tests, and may cut pesticide use.

articles.title: MIND Diet Linked to Slower Brain Aging in Long-Term Study
articles.summary: An eating plan that blends the Mediterranean diet with a blood-pressure diet was linked to slower grey matter loss over 12 years, the equivalent of 2.5 years of delayed brain aging.
